A negative value on a lower-is-better endpoint (LSD, T_τ, KID, FID) means A3 helps IXI more than Churches, the direction the claim predicts.
% note: The interaction is on each metric's raw scale, as pre-registered; where the two datasets' A0 levels differ (Churches' LSD is about five times IXI's) the raw difference is dominated by the larger scale. 'Δ / A0' (mean Δ over the mean A0 value, same seeds) is a descriptive, scale-free reading and carries no test; it is left blank for recall, coverage, the seed-NN fraction and the inherited share, which are proportions near 0 or signed.
% note: p: exact permutation of the dataset label over the six pooled per-seed Δ (C(6,3) = 20 assignments), so p cannot fall below p_min = 0.1.
% note: Only the development pair enters: OASIS-1 and Bedrooms (2 seeds, A0/A3 only) are in the transfer table 6, without p-values.
